promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.

questions.q: On the web, what is the role of a web server?
options: It stores website files and sends pages to browsers that request them
It translates IP addresses into domain names exclusively
It physically connects two computers with a cable
It only displays web pages on the user's screen
questions.explain: A web server stores the files of a website and serves the requested pages back to the user's browser.

questions.q: Which statement comparing wired and wireless connections is correct?
options: Wired connections allow users to move freely around a building
Wireless connections never suffer from interference
Wireless connections are always faster than wired ones
Wired connections are generally more stable and faster; wireless offers greater mobility
questions.explain: Wired links are typically faster and more reliable, while wireless trades some speed and stability for mobility.

questions.q: Which of the following is a benefit of cloud computing?
options: Your data is never stored on remote servers
It removes all concerns about data security
Files can be accessed from any internet-connected device
It works perfectly with no internet connection
questions.explain: A key benefit of the cloud is access to your files and applications from any device with an internet connection.

questions.q: What is a typical advantage of using robots in a car manufacturing factory?
options: They can work continuously with high precision and consistency
They never require any maintenance
They can show empathy to customers
They are always cheaper than humans in every situation
questions.explain: Robots can repeat tasks consistently and precisely for long periods without tiring.

options: Systems that improve their performance on a task by learning from data
A computer following a fixed set of rules written by a programmer
A way of storing files on optical discs
A method of compressing images without loss
questions.explain: Machine learning enables systems to improve at a task by finding patterns in data rather than being explicitly programmed with every rule.

questions.q: Which is a potential negative social impact of automation replacing manual jobs?
options: Lower running costs for businesses
Increased unemployment in some sectors
Faster production speeds
More consistent product quality
questions.explain: Automation can displace human workers, leading to job losses in some industries.

questions.q: Which of the following is a drawback of cloud computing?
options: Storage can be increased easily
It relies on a stable internet connection to access data
Backups are handled by the provider
You can collaborate with others in real time
questions.explain: Cloud services depend on internet access, so you may be unable to reach your data if the connection fails.

questions.q: Which is a realistic concern raised by the growth of artificial intelligence?
options: Bias in decisions if the AI is trained on biased data
AI converting all files to hexadecimal
AI removing the need for any electricity
AI making all data storage volatile
questions.explain: If AI is trained on biased data, it can make unfair or biased decisions, which is a significant ethical concern.

questions.q: When you type a website address into a browser, which system translates the domain name into an IP address?
options: The hard disk controller
The DNS (Domain Name System)
The operating system kernel
The ALU
questions.explain: The DNS translates human-readable domain names into the numeric IP addresses computers use to locate servers.

questions.q: Which technology allows devices to connect to a network without cables?
options: Wi-Fi
A USB cable
Fibre-optic cabling
Ethernet
questions.explain: Wi-Fi uses radio waves to connect devices to a network wirelessly.
